text: Turbulent Treads is a token that is used to create a Feet-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Turbulent Robes is a token that is used to create a Chest-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Turbulent Spaulders is a token that is used to create a Shoulder-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Turbulent Choker is a token that is used to create a Neck-slot armor suitable for a character's specialization.
Turbulent Bracers is a token that is used to create a Wrist-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Turn is the son of Ferra Leafheart. He has undergone his trials to become a shaman.
Turbax is one of three snails that can be found racing around a pillar in the Stone Market in Neltharion's Lair. His racing companions are Whipsnap and Blaze.
Tuskarr Fighters are tuskarr fighter creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
Tuskarr Spearmen are tuskarr spearman creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
__NOTOC__ Tuskarr Healers are tuskarr healer creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
__NOTOC__ Tuskarr Trappers are tuskarr trapper creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
Tuskarr Warriors are tuskarr warrior creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
__NOTOC__ Tuskarr Sorcerers are tuskarr sorcerer creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
__NOTOC__ Tuskarr Chieftains are tuskarr creeps that can be encountered in the Icecrown Glacier tileset.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Augurs are humans located in Mount Hyjal.
Tushui Emissaries were pandaren located in Alliance capital cities to access the Temple of Kotmogu battleground.
Tweets' Flavorful Flan is sold by Gordon Fine and Lidia Plank in Tiragarde Sound.
Twenty-One Arms Salute was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 21.
Twilight-Harbinger Tharuul is a void revenant located near Viceroy Nezhar in the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Tusajia is a Zandalari troll located at the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun, conversing with Vanashi. She is initially known as Akunda the Verbose but resumes her true name after completion of Ending the Madness.
Tusk Wax is looted from Jani's Stash in Vol'dun and the Gift of the Brokenhearted in Zuldazar.
Twiddle Twirler: Sentinel's Glaive drops from Commander Ral'esh in Darkshore.
Twiddle Twirler: Shredder Blade drops from Burninator Mark V in Darkshore.
Tuwavo Ravenwing is a tauren located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Tussle Tonks Fanatics are Mechagon mechagnomes located in Operation: Mechagon.

Tweekette is a vulpera located in Tiragarde Sound. She is passed out under the wooden walkway behind the inn of Hatherford, in a pile of straw, surrounded by a hookah, take-out boxes, a musical instrument, and other things.
Tuskarr Whaler's Harpoon drops from Whargarble the Ill-Tempered in Drustvar.
Tussle Tonks is an encounter located in Operation: Mechagon. It consists of The Platinum Pummeler and Gnomercy 4.U..
Tuurem Artifacts were to drop from Tuurem Scavengers and Tuurem Hunters at Tuurem in Terokkar Forest for Artifacts from Tuurem.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Armsmen are tauren, jungle troll, human, and dwarf warriors who are part of the Twilight's Hammer. They can be slain for The Twilight Plot.
Tushui Guardians are located in in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Abductors are members of the Twilight's Hammer located in the Twilight Highlands.
Twilight Ascendants are elemental ascendants located in the Twilight Depths in Deepholm.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Bark is sold by Inscription vendors in the Shadowlands. It can also be mined from Phaedrum Deposits and Rich Phaedrum Deposits in Ardenweald. It is also a reward from the following missions: *Memory Error *Pride of the Forest *Seed Thieves
__NOTOC__ Turbulent Juice are oozes located at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.
Turn of the Tide is an Azerite trait available to Restoration shaman.
__NOTOC__ Turbulent Lifefury is a water elemental located in Thunder Totem.
The Twenty-Loop Violet Girdle rarely drops from the Violet Mistake in Maldraxxus.
Tuskarr Tribesmen are tuskarr warriors from Kamagua that can be summoned by using the Horn of Kamagua. They assist the adventurers in retaking the village of Iskaal from pirates.

Twigin, the best friend of Navigator Xennir, is a tiny deathroc who appears during the :Necrolords Campaign. According to Xennir herself, her skills are useless without Twigin's direction. Twigin is first found in the Bony Spindles, having been trapped in a web by the spiders who once served the House of Eyes. Xennir asks Maw Walkers to rescue Twigin from the web using the spiders' caustic venom, after which he joins Xennir inside Nurakkir. The bird later flies the Maw Walkers to the Ossein Foundry to begin the mission of stealing the necropolis Zerekriss. He subsequently helps transport them to the necropolis' apex and then down into the main chamber. Once the Zerekriss has been captured fo
The Turbulent Greataxe is created with a Turbulent Armament.
Tuskarr Relics drop from Kvaldir Mist Lords and Kvaldir Mistweavers at Garrosh's Landing in the Borean Tundra.
The Tusk Pools are a location in Zuldazar. It contains Tusk Hollow.
Twilight's Edge Spaulders drop from L'ura in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Turkey Parts could be combined to create a Wild Turkey (item).
Tweedle's Blastproof Legguards are a quest reward from Blastranaar!.
Tuskarr Cudgel is a world drop and is looted from Froststeel Lockbox.
The Turkey Soul is obtained by receiving The Spirit of Sharing buff, and then sampling every meal one additional time.
Tussle Tonks Fanatics are Mechagon mechagnomes located in Operation: Mechagon and the Robodrome.
Tuskarr Spirit Shawl is a quest reward from Echoes of the Fallen in the Azure Span.
Tuskarr Homesteaders are tuskarr located on Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach.
Tutaqan is a tuskarr located at Uktulut Backwater in the Waking Shores.
Tuskarr Training Dummies are training dummies located at Uktulut Backwater in the Waking Shores. Uktulut Trainees are seen practicing their skills on them.
Twice-Baked Potato is a snack dish created with Dragon Isles Cooking (1); taught by Recipe: Twice-Baked Potato.

__NOTOC__ The Turquoise Baubleworm is a baubleworm companion. It can be purchased from Keeper Ta'hult in Oribos for 1 Rabbit's Foot, 1 Large Slimy Bone, and A Frayed Knot. These items drop in various places around the world.
Twice-Burnt Potato is a trash item created with Dragon Isles Cooking.
Tuskar Fishing Gear is crafted by Tavio in Iskaara in the Azure Span. The gear is split up into several categories.
Tuukanit is a tuskarr vendor located in Iskaara in the Azure Span.
__NOTOC__ The Tuskarr Shoreglider is a tuskarr glider mount. This mount is not available in Classic.
Tweetums was a mechanical chicken located next to the Review Collection Box at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. Its ID was reused by Quax.
Tuskarr Children are tuskarr children located on Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach. They are often seen with Ottuk Pups.
Tuskarr Guards are tuskarr located on Morqut Islet and Tempest Coast in the Forbidden Reach. Some are patrolling their settlement on giant ottuks.
Tuskarr Elders are tuskarr located on Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach.
Tuskarr Sailors are tuskarr located on the Tempest Coast in the Forbidden Reach.
Tuskarr Headwear becomes available at Renown level 6 with the Iskaara Tuskarr.
Tuskarr Champion's Tales becomes available at Renown level 5 with the Iskaara Tuskarr.
__NOTOC__ Twigs is a black drakonid located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores.
The Tuskarr Stone Table is found in the Kauriq Gleamlet in the Azure Span. It holds the spirit of Kauriq the Gleamfisher. Offering Basket is found on it.
Tuskarr Travelers are tuskarr located in Iskaara and Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Tuskarr Workers are tuskarr located at a trading outpost in the Azure Span.
Tuskarr Whalers are tuskarr located in Whaler's Nook in the Azure Span. They hunt Seafoam Scuttlers.

Tuskarr Jerky drops from the following gnolls in Brackenhide Water Hole in the Azure Span: *Darktooth Stalker *Darktooth Battler *Darktooth Skirmisher *Darktooth Spirit-Caller 20x are needed to obtain Temperamental Skyclaw from Zon'Wogi.
Tutaqan's Commendation is a quest reward from While the Iron Is Hot in the Azure Span.
Tusk Marrow drops from mammoths and magmammoths in the Dragon Isles.
Turik is the tuskarr renown envoy of Iskaara Tuskarr in Morqut Village of the Forbidden Reach.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Ambushers are orcs, jungle trolls, and Forsaken located in the Twilight Highlands.
Twilight's Hammer Horses are horses located in the Twilight Highlands.

Turbulent Timeways is a multiple-week long event for the Timewalking events. For each week on daily reset day, it'll switch to a new expansion event. During this event, the weekly quests available from Kazra in Valdrakken will instead offer a Heroic level Cache of Vault Treasures#Heroic that will contain increased item levels. After this event has run its course, the rewards will return to the original ilvl.

Turi Flickerflame is a gnome located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. Turi is a former apprentice of the late Rhonin and the leader of the Sullied Banner, a rogue mage sect, that wanted to create mana bombs. She also wanted to give closure to her followers after the destruction of Theramore and the death of Rhonin. As she was working on three mobs at once, an adventurer sent by Surigosa and Kalecgos defeated her. Instead of killing her, she was taken back to the dragons for examination. She then spoke with Kalec and expressed disappointment and sadness over the loss of Theramore and its circumstances. Kalec wanted to speak with her further about the future she wanted to build for her f

Tuskarr Trader's Vest is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Tuskarr Trader's Leather Armor.

Tuskarr Puddle Steppers are a quest reward from Ruriq's River Rapids Ride.
Tuskarr Dinghy is an achievement reward from River Rapids Wrangler.
Twenty-Two-League Striders drop from Azureblade in the Azure Vault.
Tuskarr Offering was never made available. The quest is instead offered by Elder Poa in the Azure Span.
Tuskarr Water Kickers are a quest reward from Ruriq's River Rapids Ride.

Tuskarr Ceremonial Spear is the reward for Rise in Relic Theft, the first daily quest of Secrets of Azeroth, started by Preservationist Kathos in the Roasted Ram of Valdrakken. Head to the Filled Bowl of Iskaara, and speak with Elder Poa: This shows a pop-up: : Accepting the pop-up turns the Tuskarr Ceremonial Spear into Shomko's Unyielding Spear and Poa's gossip continues: Head to Shomko's Unyielding Spear for the next step in the secret.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Keeper Mayna is a human. Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. To decipher them, a the book is used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations. The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers. She is guarding the first chapter of the book in the camp in the far west of Silithus.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Keeper Exeter is a human. Some of the Twilight's Hammer Cult cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. To decipher them, a the book is used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations. The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers. He is guarding the second chapter of the book in the camp in the southwest of North Silithus.

Some of the Twilight's Hammer cult members carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. To decipher them, a book is used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations. Mayna, Havunth, and Exeter are the keepers of them and are known as the Twilight Keepers.

The Twilight Lexicons are books used by Twilight's Hammer Cult scribes to encode secret messages that are actually kept in three separate chapters in different locations by the Twilight Keepers to safeguard their encryption method.

Twilight Trappings was a quest set required for summonings at Wind stones in Silithus prior to Cataclysm. Equipping all three applied the aura spell "Twilight Cultist Disguise". While the item set became useless with the removal of the related Silithus quests, the set bonus remained in the game until Patch 7.1.5.

Twilight Vale is the name of the southern forests of Darkshore, starting south of Ameth'Aran until the border with Ashenvale. Like the rest of Darkshore, the woods of the Twilight Vale are crawling with corrupted furbolgs, feral nightsabers, and rabid bears. Travelers are advised to stick to the roads when traveling through the vale. During the War of the Thorns, the area was a battlefield between the Horde and the night elves. In the Battle for Darkshore, while Darkshore is under Alliance control, the Bilgewater Cartel uses this area for logging and poaching. When Darkshore is under Horde control, the Druids of the Branch use it to grow treants.
A Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship was only given to high ranking members of the Twilight Council, to allow them communication with the Abyssal Lords.
Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station is a quest reward from Dukes of the Council and Medallion of Station.
Twilight Pendant drops from the following mobs in Blackfathom Deeps: *Twilight Acolyte *Twilight Aquamancer *Twilight Shadowmage *Twilight Loreseeker *Twilight Elementalist *Twilight Reaver
Twilight Void Bracers are Level 48 quality Mail Bracers that improves Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.
Twilight Geolords is the first quest in the Twilight Geolords quest chain.

Twilight Cultist Mantle is cloth shoulder armor that was used for summonings at the Wind Stones in Silithus prior to Cataclysm. One set was consumed per Summoning. It is part of the Twilight Trappings set.
Twilight Cultist Robe was a robe used for summonings at the Wind stones in Silithus prior to Cataclysm. One set was consumed per Summoning. It is part of the Twilight Trappings set.

Twilight Cultist Cowl is cloth head armor that was used for summonings at the Wind Stones in Silithus prior to Cataclysm. One set was consumed per Summoning. It was part of the Twilight Trappings set.

__NOTOC__ The Twilight Prophet is a human found in Silithus. The Prophet has an escort of 2 or 4 Twilight Avengers. Commander Mar'alith wants the battle orders carried by the Prophet. The Prophet also always carries a large number of Encrypted Twilight Text, usually 7 or 8.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Marauder Morna is a human found in Silithus. She is surrounded by her Twilight Marauder peers. Windcaller Proudhorn wants Morna killed.
Twill Pants are a world drop from mobs in the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
Twill Shoulderpads are a world drop from level 49 - 70 mobs.
Twill Cover is looted from the Plain Hat Box. It is also a world drop from level 49 - 70 mobs.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Geolords can be found at the Twilight camps in Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab, they can drop pieces of the Twilight set, which are used during the event to summon bosses.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Fire Guards are night elves, humans, Forsaken, and dwarves found in Searing Gorge.
Twilight Bodyguards are members of the Twilight's Hammer that can be found in Blackrock Depths.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Marauders are humans found in Silithus. They ride around protecting Twilight Marauder Morna wherever she goes. Killing them will result in +1 reputation with Cenarion Circle.
Twilight Orb is a random world drop from level 39-45 creatures.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Thugs are found at Master's Glaive in Darkshore.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Geomancers are night elves, dwarves, orcs, and gnomes located at Firewatch Ridge in Searing Gorge.

The Twilight Correspondence contains important information for the Earthen Ring regarding the Twilight's Hammer's activities involving the Midsummer Fire Festival outside of Blackfathom Deeps at the Zoram Strand of Ashenvale
__NOTOC__ Twilight Firesworn are members of the Twilight's Hammer located in the Zoram Strand of Ashenvale during the Midsummer Fire Festival.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Flameguards are members of the Twilight's Hammer located in the Zoram Strand of Ashenvale, and are part of the Midsummer Fire Festival.

Twilight Frostblades are members of the Twilight's Hammer located just southwest of the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula during the Midsummer Fire Festival. They share spawn points with s. They are (indirectly) involved in the following quest: *Striking Back (Hellfire Peninsula)

Twilight Cryomancers are frost mages of various races located just southwest of the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula during the Midsummer Fire Festival. They share spawn points with Twilight Frostblades. They are (indirectly) involved in the following quest: *Striking Back (Hellfire Peninsula)
Twilight Emissaries are members of the Twilight's Hammer that can be found in Blackrock Depths.

Twilight Opals can be mined rarely from Rich Saronite and Cobalt Deposits, and Titanium Veins. They may also be mined from some mobs, and prospected from cobalt or saronite ore. In Patch 3.2, this gem is no longer available for purchase from any vendor, and has been replaced by its epic version, Dreadstone.
The Twilight Rivulet runs from the Decrepit Flow to the Mirror of Twilight beneath Dalaran in western Crystalsong Forest.

Twilight Vanquisher is a title awarded when you complete The Twilight Zone (25 player) from slaying Sartharion the Onyx Guardian with all three Twilight Drakes alive. The title appears in front of your character's name: :Twilight Vanquisher ""
Twin-Headed Boots drop from Lavanthor in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.

__NOTOC__ The Twilight Drakonaar is one of the two creatures that can be released during the fourth wave of the Harbinger Skyriss encounter in the Arcatraz. This fight is similar to the chromatic drakonid that can be found in Nefarian's encounter in Blackwing Lair.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Stonecaller are Twilight mobs located in Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab, they can drop pieces of the Twilight set, which are used during the event to summon bosses.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Flamereavers are Twilight mobs located in Twilight's Run in northeastern Silithus.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Masters are Twilight mobs located at the Twilight Outpost in southwestern in Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab, they can drop pieces of the Twilight set, which are used during the event to summon bosses.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Overlords are Twilight mobs located at Staghelm Point and Twilight's Run in northeastern Silithus.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Speaker Viktor is a Forsaken located at Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. He is a part of the Midsummer Fire Festival.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Dark Shaman are jungle trolls, tauren, and orcs located at Firewatch Ridge in Searing Gorge.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Idolaters are humans located at Firewatch Ridge in Searing Gorge.
Twilight Darkcasters are found in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom in Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Frost Mages are frost mages of the Twilight's Hammer on the Descent into Madness in Ulduar.
Twilight Initiates are found in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom in Dragonblight. They need to be killed in order to start the fight against Jedoga Shadowseeker.

Twilight Volunteers are found in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom in Dragonblight. They appear after killing the Twilight Initiates during the Jedoga Shadowseeker boss fight, during the fight Jedoga will call one forth to be sacrificed.
Twilight Pyromancers are pyromancers of the Twilight's Hammer on the Descent into Madness in Ulduar. They have fire elementals as pets and are immune to mind control.
Twilight Shadowblades are orcs found in the Hall of Memories in Ulduar.
Twilight Slayers are vrykul of the Twilight's Hammer in Ulduar.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Worshippers are jungle trolls and tauren found in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom in Dragonblight.
Twilight Duo (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for engaging and defeating Sartharion in Obsidian Sanctum on 10-player mode with at least two Twilight Drakes still alive.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Firelance is a common item used during a set of quests in the Firelands Hatchery. They can be found on a pair of weapon racks behind Farden Talonshrike. The Twilight Firelance is a weapon used while mounted on one of Aviana's Guardians.
Twilight Recruitment Papers is a quest item for Signed in Blood.
The Twilight Blockade was an area of land located immediately east of Wolf's Run and west of Circle of Cinders in Mount Hyjal.
Twilight Overlook was a small Twilight's Hammer outpost on the upper shelf of Deepholm. The Earthen Ring, having defeated the cultists, now hold the camp.
Twilight Torturers are ogre magi found in Blackrock Caverns.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Zealots are found in Blackrock Caverns. They can be transformed into Evolved Twilight Zealots.
Twilight Element Wardens are tauren found at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Blackrock Caverns.
Twilight Obsidian Borer are humans found in Blackrock Caverns.
Twilight Element of Air is found in the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
Twilight Element of Earth is found in the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
Twilight Element of Fire is found in the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
Twilight Element of Water is found in the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
Twilight Orders drop from Twilight Bloodshapers at Deathwing's Fall in Deepholm.
Twilight Research Notes drop from Mercurial Oozes in Deepholm.
The Twilight Snare drops from the following members of the Twilight's Hammer in Deepholm: *Scalesworn Cultist *Twilight Dragonstalker
__NOTOC__ Twilight Flame Callers are humans found in the Chamber of Incineration in the Blackrock Caverns.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Jasmine is an herb found in the Twilight Highlands.
__NOTOC__ The Twillight Cage Key drops from Twilight Champions and Twilight Candidates in the Abyssal Depths.
Twilight Collars drop from s, s, , and s in the Searing Gorge.
Twilight Slaver's Key is contained in the Slavemaster's Coffer in Deepholm.
The Twilight Enclave is an area within the Bastion of Twilight, where Valiona and Theralion are fought.
__NOTOC__ The Twilight Breach is rift found at the center Twilight Highlands. It is located southwest of Thundermar, north of Victor's Point and very close to Wyrms' Bend.

The Twilight Gate is an ogre village made up of the Bloodeye clan found in the Twilight Highlands. It contains several stone buildings and an ogre mound. The path up to the Twilight Citadel is behind the settlement.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Landshaper is some kind of artifact capable of changing the land around it. It's found at the Twilight Camp in the northern area of the lake of Loch Modan.

The Twilight Council (or Twilight's Council) appears to be a leading group in the Twilight's Hammer. The members are called "Lords of the Twilight Council". They were the only ones allowed to speak to the Lords of the Abyssal Council, and therefore got a Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship. Cho'gall drops the Hands of the Twilight Council, so he may be a member.
Twilight Shadow Knights are the first mobs you will encounter in the Bastion of Twilight. Found in the Bastion Antechamber.

Twilight Skymaster Richtofen is a level 44 mob located at Thousand Needles. He's a member of the Twilight's Hammer and is in charge of capturing all wyverns at Highperch, commanding the twilight forces from his base camp known as the Twilight Aerie.
__NOTOC__ Twilight's Vindicators are paladins working for the Twilight's Hammer. They are stationed at the Twilight Citadel of Twilight Highlands, area surrounding Bastion of Twilight's spire.
Twilight Overseer's Key drops from Twilight Overseers near the Twilight Command Post in Mount Hyjal.

The Twilight Command Post is a large Twilight's Hammer outpost found in the northern part of Verdant Thicket atop Mount Hyjal. The cultists have been changing the land to suit their needs and style. Scout Larandia is being held prisoner here.
Twilight Dragonspawn are twilight dragonspawn found at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

The Twilight Gauntlet is the Twilight's Hammer proving grounds within the Darkwhisper Gorge of Mount Hyjal. It is here new recruits are given the task of collecting Flame Blossoms for Condenna the Pitiless. Should the recruits survive encounters with the fire elementals and avoid encounters with Smolderos the Carbonizer they would be welcomed into the cult. Another Twilight instructor, Cargall, is found near Condenna offering a quest to give recruits that have failed the trial a "second chance".
Twilight Leg Armor is a permanent legs enchantment optimized for tanks.
The Twilight Scale Chestguard is crafted with Cataclysm Leatherworking (75); Taught by Pattern: Twilight Scale Chestguard.

The Twilight Cauldron is a cauldron bubbling near Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal. The Twilight's Hammer are using it to mix a formula that is particularly noxious. (The hero finds this out by dumping it out so he can use it to brew a potion of his own. Nearby plant life dies immediately on contact.) The hero brews a draught that is horrible to see or smell, but not harmful so much as shocking - the hero uses it to shock people who have been enslaved and mind controlled by the Twilight's Hammer out of their madness.
Twilight Highlands Coastal Chart is given by Herezegor Flametusk in Orgrimmar.
Twilight of the Dragons is the 15th normal TCG expansion, released on July 26, 2011. It is set 3 of the Worldbreaker Block.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Bruisers are orcs found in Galakrond's Rest in Hour of Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Rangers are humans found in Galakrond's Rest in Hour of Twilight. They are rangers of the Twilight's Hammer.

Twilight Siege Captains are human captains of the Twilight's Hammer found in Dragon Soul, they can be seen in groups of four creating a portal summoning elementals to attack Wyrmrest Temple. After Morchok is killed, they leave as the Twilights Hammer retreats.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Frost Evokers are humans found in the Eye of Eternity in the Dragon Soul.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Shadow-Walkers are jungle trolls found in Galakrond's Rest in the Hour of Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Ettins are ettins found at the Twilight Gate in the Twilight Highlands.
Twilight Crossfires are the first mobs encountered in the Bastion Antechamber in the Bastion of Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Dark Menders are the first trash mobs encountered in the Bastion Antechamber in the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Phase-Twisters are the first trash mobs encountered in the Bastion Antechamber in the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Soul Blades are orcs found in the Bastion Antechamber in Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Brutes are ogres located in the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Fiends are fleshbeasts seen during the encounter as well as the achievement Double Dragon.
Twilight Sentries are twilight dragonspawn located in the Twilight Enclave in the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Portal Shapers are humans found inside the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Shadow Menders are ogre mages located in the Bastion of Twilight.
Twilight Spitecallers are twilight dragonspawn located in the Twilight Caverns in the Bastion of Twilight.

Twilight Recruiter Maruk is a tauren of the Twilight's Hammer located on Mount Hyjal. He is watching over Twilight Recruits who were inspired to join the cult after Ragnaros' emergence, and becomes friendly to spying adventurers after Your New Identity.
Twilight Drakes are summoned by Twilight Wyrmcaller inside Grim Batol.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Proveditors are ogres serving the Twilight's Hammer at Wolf's Run in Mount Hyjal. They maintain a supply line alongside the Twilight Slavedrivers and their Twilight Slaves, carrying Twilight Supplies. Servants of Cho'gall, these ogres have pledged that they will give a pound of their flesh for every pound of supplies they fail to deliver, and would rather die than fail their master.

__NOTOC__ Twilight Hunters are jungle trolls, orcs, dwarves of the Twilight's Hammer located at Wolf's Run in Mount Hyjal. They hunt game to extinction in the parts of the forest that haven't been set on fire, and seem to have a taste for people, though whether that's out of preference or desperation is unknown.

Twilight Ritualists are members of the Twilight's Hammer found in the Tirisfal Glades. During the fifth stage of Blade in Twilight, they are channeling void energy to dampen the wards in the Tomb of Tyr. During The Sword of Kings, they are imprisoning Thoradin's ghost at the Twilight's Hammer camp in the Whispering Forest.
